Margo’s Got Money Troubles. | Image: Apple

Apple TV is best known for its lineup of science fiction shows and feel-good sitcoms , but of late the streaming service has veered in a different direction. A pair of its current buzziest shows explore the world of OnlyFans creators and cam models, and they're timed up near perfectly; just as one ends ( Margo's Got Money Troubles ) another is set to begin ( Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed ). According to Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed creator and showrunner David J. Rosen, the timing is something of a coincidence, but also indicative of the current moment.
